idea: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.

messages.content: Build a task manager app where users create tasks, get reminders, upload files, and export reports.

To ensure we capture all IEEE-style requirements for your task manager, I'll guide you through 7 simple questions—no technical knowledge needed. Let's start by defining user roles and core functionality.

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the requirements for Task Manager, providing a comprehensive definition of system functionality, user interactions, and technical specifications to guide development and ensure alignment with business objectives.

product_scope.summary: Task Manager is a web application that enables users to create, organize, and track tasks with reminders, file attachments, and reporting capabilities to enhance personal and team productivity.
business_objectives: Provide users with a centralized platform for task management
Enable efficient tracking of task progress and deadlines
Support file management and document organization
Generate actionable reports for productivity analysis
benefits: Improved task organization and completion rates
Reduced missed deadlines through automated reminders
goals: Deliver a fully functional task management system within 6 months
Achieve 95% user satisfaction for core task management features
Support export of task data in JSON and PDF formats

product_perspective.system_context: Task Manager operates as a standalone web application accessible through modern browsers, featuring a responsive frontend, RESTful API backend, database storage, and integration capabilities for file management and notification services.

product_functions.name: Task Creation and Management
product_functions.description: Allows users to create, edit, delete, and organize tasks with titles, descriptions, due dates, priorities, and categories.

product_functions.name: Reminder System
product_functions.description: Provides configurable reminders through email and browser notifications for upcoming and overdue tasks.

product_functions.name: File Attachment Management
product_functions.description: Enables users to upload, view, and manage files associated with specific tasks with size and format restrictions.

product_functions.name: Reporting and Export
product_functions.description: Generates comprehensive reports on task completion, productivity metrics, and exports data in JSON and PDF formats.

user_classes_and_characteristics.description: Primary users who create and manage personal tasks, set reminders, and track personal productivity
Users who oversee team tasks, generate reports, and monitor team productivity metrics

user_interfaces.name: Reports Dashboard
user_interfaces.description: Interface for generating and viewing productivity reports with export options and customizable date ranges.

software_interfaces.description: JSON-based API for all task operations, file management, and report generation with standardized error handling and authentication.
Integration interface for cloud storage providers supporting file upload, download, and management operations.
External service integration for sending email and SMS reminders with templated messages and delivery status tracking.

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

File metadata shall be stored separately from actual file content
User preferences and settings shall be persisted across sessions
Report generation data shall be optimized for query performance
Database backups shall occur daily with point-in-time recovery capability

analyst_workspace.analysis_summary: This Software Requirements Specification defines the requirements for a comprehensive task management application designed for general public and student users. The system enables users to create and manage tasks with reminders, file attachments, and reporting capabilities across web and mobile platforms. Key features include email/password authentication, integration with email services and calendar systems, and support for both in-app notifications and email updates. The application handles personal data with standard privacy protections and is designed to scale for up to 100 concurrent users at launch.
